coverage_limits: Lexical Swift checks, not a Swift compiler or whole-program data-flow analysis.
String interpolation and aliases may require semantic follow-up; no AST guarantee is claimed.
SnapshotTestingKit inventories the local checkout; active SnapshotTestKit target/linkage inspection is pending.
ComponentIdentifier validates registered members, namespace format, and direct/indirect construction lexically; arbitrary cross-module runtime aliases are not resolved by static lexical scanning.
Generated Swift and color assets are scanned; no implicit generated-file or fixture-pixel exclusion.
Fixture pixel exceptions, generator provenance and production/test product linkage remain follow-up work.
Computed-property symbol returns, font/spacing recipes and arbitrary aliases are not yet resolved.
